description: List the named steel sections FERS knows: European (IPE, HEA, HEB, HEM, UPE, RHS, SHS, CHS, L), UK (UB, UC, PFC) and US (W, HP, HSS, Pipe). check_beam and create_beam require one of these names, so call this rather than guessing. Returns names only — use get_section for a section's properties. Free.

family.description: Filter by family/prefix, e.g. 'IPE', 'HEA', 'RHS'. Case-insensitive. Omit for all families.

name: list_sections
title: List steel sections
